independence_scope.oshb_uxlc_status: correlated WLC-family views, not independent textual votes

route.title: Dated opening word and quoted delay claim
route.deciding_seam: Hag.1.1 supplies the date, היה דבר־יהוה word-event formula, addressees, and לאמר introduction; Hag.1.2 supplies the quoted לא עת ... בית־יהוה להבנות claim; a WLC-family pe follows 1:2 before the renewed word event at 1:3.
route.counterevidence: The date and addressee notice is formally recoverable metadata, but it is syntactically incomplete without the saying it introduces.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.1.1 as an authorship, office, genealogy, date, chronology, or Persian-period reconstruction claim.
Do not use Ezra's references to decide the local boundary or historical reconstruction.

route.title: Paneled-house accusation and futility register
route.deciding_seam: ויהי דבר־יהוה repeats the word event at 1:3; the paneled-house question leads to שימו לבבכם על־דרכיכם and the cumulative sowing, eating, drinking, clothing, and wages register; a WLC-family pe follows 1:6.
rejected_alternatives: Separate chunks for individual futility outcomes
route.counterevidence: Hag.1.3 is a speech frame and 1:6 is a highly memorable list, but the frame, accusation, summons, and consequences form one complete oracle.
proof_text_risks: Never isolate Hag.1.6 as a universal prosperity formula or causal rule.
Do not convert the futility register into an individual financial, vocational, or moral diagnosis.

route.title: Building commission, disappointed expectation, and drought explanation
route.deciding_seam: כה אמר יהוה צבאות and שימו לבבכם restart at 1:7; the עלו, הבאתם, ובנו imperatives at 1:8 lead to pleasure/glory, disappointed expectation, the יען מה explanation, withheld dew and yield, and the called drought; a WLC-family samekh follows 1:11.
route.counterevidence: The imperative commission at 1:8 and the causal judgment beginning at 1:9 are distinct internal movements, but accusation, commission, failed expectation, and explanation are mutually dependent.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.1.8 as a generic building, fundraising, institutional, or temple-legitimacy command.
Never isolate Hag.1.9-11 to authorize a prosperity doctrine, environmental explanation, or historical reconstruction.

route.title: Communal obedience, presence assurance, stirring, work, and date coda
route.deciding_seam: וישמע at 1:12 changes from oracle to narrated obedience; אני אתכם at 1:13 answers that response; ויער יהוה and the work report continue through 1:14; a WLC-family pe follows 1:14, but the date in 1:15 syntactically completes the work report before the new dated word event at 2:1.
route.counterevidence: The pe after 1:14 strongly supports a date-coda child seam, while the messenger speech at 1:13 is a distinct embedded oracle. Hag.1.15 remains too dependent to surface separately.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.1.13 as an unconditional presence slogan apart from obedience, stirring, and work.
Never surface Hag.1.15 as an isolated chronology claim or use it to settle Persian-period history.

route.title: Dated former-glory question and encouragement oracle
route.deciding_seam: Hag.2.1-2 gives a new date, word event, and addressees; the former-glory questions at 2:3 lead to the threefold חזק, ועשו, כי אני אתכם sequence in 2:4 and covenant, Spirit, and אל־תיראו reassurance in 2:5; a WLC-family samekh follows 2:5.
route.counterevidence: The threefold encouragement at 2:4 and covenant/Spirit reassurance at 2:5 are internally recoverable, while the larger 2:1-9 oracle continues causally at 2:6.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.2.4-5 as generic courage, work, covenant, Spirit, presence, or fear-not promises.
Exodus-related covenant and presence parallels are contextual evidence only and cannot decide history, theology, translation, or boundary.

route.title: Shaking, nations, house glory, and peace promise
route.deciding_seam: כי כה אמר יהוה צבאות restarts at 2:6 with עוד אחת מעט היא and creation shaking; nations, חמדת כל־הגוים, silver, gold, latter house glory, and peace continue through 2:9; a WLC-family pe follows 2:9.
route.counterevidence: Repeated speech formulas and the silver/gold declaration at 2:8 create internal turns, but shaking resolves specifically in house glory and peace.
proof_text_risks: Never detach shaking, nations, desired or valuable things, silver, gold, latter glory, or peace as independent predictions or prosperity claims.
Hebrews 12 reception of Hag.2.6 is evidence only and cannot decide the temporal force of עוד אחת, fulfillment, theology, translation, or the local seam.

route.title: Dated priestly instruction dialogue and prophetic application
route.deciding_seam: Hag.2.10 gives the date and word event; שאל־נא את־הכהנים תורה opens the inquiry at 2:11; 2:12 and 2:13 form paired question-answer exchanges; ויען חגי ... כן העם הזה applies their asymmetry to people, nation, work, and offering at 2:14; ועתה שימו־נא begins retrospective application at 2:15.
route.counterevidence: Each priestly exchange is formally complete and 2:14 changes from dialogue to application, but neither answer safely represents the passage without the paired case and prophetic application.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.2.12 or Hag.2.13 as a contextless ritual, purity, legal, ethical, or doctrinal rule.
Do not use roots, glosses, later legal harmonization, or priestly terminology to select a total meaning or preferred law.

route.title: Retrospective shortfall, foundation-day hinge, and blessing reversal
route.deciding_seam: ועתה שימו־נא לבבכם מן־היום הזה ומעלה begins retrospective shortfall at 2:15; reduced stores, blight, mildew, hail, and failed return continue through 2:17; שימו־נא לבבכם repeats at 2:18 with the foundation-day threshold; 2:19 moves from absent produce to מן־היום הזה אברך; a WLC-family samekh follows 2:19.
route.counterevidence: The repeated consider formula and explicit foundation-day date in 2:18 strongly support two dependent children. The larger surface better preserves the shortfall-to-blessing reversal and protects 2:19 from isolated retrieval.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.2.19 as an unconditional from-today blessing, agricultural guarantee, prosperity promise, or chronological formula.
Do not infer temple legitimacy, historical causation, or a universal reward rule from the foundation-day hinge.

route.title: Second same-day Zerubbabel overthrow and signet oracle
route.deciding_seam: ויהי דבר־יהוה שנית marks a second same-day word at 2:20; אמר אל־זרבבל supplies the direct addressee at 2:21; shaking, overthrow of kingdoms and chariots, mutual sword, ביום ההוא, עבדי, כחותם, כי בך בחרתי, and the closing speech formula continue through 2:23.
route.counterevidence: Hag.2.23 changes from broad overthrow imagery to direct servant/signet/election language and is highly retrievable, but it is the addressed culmination of the same oracle.
proof_text_risks: Never detach Hag.2.23 to settle royal, Davidic, messianic, servant, office, election, signet, identity, or fulfillment claims.
Whole-Bible servant or signet parallels and Ezra references are retrieval context only.

preserved_boundary_dissents.alternative: Hag.1.12-Hag.1.14 plus dependent date coda Hag.1.15

preserved_boundary_dissents.evidence: Former-glory questions shift to threefold encouragement at Hag.2.4.
The consider refrain restarts with the foundation-day threshold at Hag.2.18.

source_gaps: OSHB and UXLC are correlated WLC-family views and cannot count as independent textual witnesses.
No authorized passage-pinned primary LXX, DSS, Targum, rabbinic, ANE, Persian-period, or Second-Temple packet was available.

The covenant/Spirit relation in Hag.2.5, the temporal force of yet once more in Hag.2.6, the rendering and referent of חמדת כל־הגוים in Hag.2.7, and the servant/signet/election language in Hag.2.23 remain unresolved.

The permitted sources do not authorize a preferred reading, translation, date, historical reconstruction, priestly ruling, temple status, royal or messianic identity, fulfillment, theology, or promotion.
